ownershipView.note: Founders own ~71%: free float only ~29%. Promoter shares are locked in until 18 months after listing (May-2027) for the minimum promoter contribution (SEBI ICDR; exact split not read).

governanceView: Board of six: three independent directors (chair Deepak Amitabh), two founder executives and one WestBridge nominee. Auditor S.R. Batliboi (EY). Founders cut their own pay by 84% and 61% in FY26. Positives: channel EBITDA now auditor-reviewed; FinZ lending exited after investor pushback. Watch: many EBITDA definitions; related-party and acquisition put options (redemption liability); Q1 results filed on the last permitted day.
industryView: India's education market ₹15-16 lakh crore (FY25); test preparation ₹1.0-1.1 lakh crore (~7%); online penetration of education ~4% (Redseer in AR FY26 MD&A). Test-prep TAM ~6 crore students growing 13-15% (management, Q3FY26 call). Competitors: Allen and Aakash (offline JEE/NEET leaders), Unacademy, Vedantu, regional coaching. Regulation: Ministry of Education guidelines for coaching centres circulated to states on 16-Jan-2024 (registration, no enrolment below 16 or before secondary-school exams, graduate tutors; advisory until states legislate; Business Today 19-Jan-2024); NEET moving online from 2027 (NTA).

moat.why: 142 mn+ social subscribers; ads only 9.1% of revenue (FY26) yet 4.87 mn paying online users.
~₹4,000 a year versus ₹1-2 lakh offline; one teacher to many; online margin ~27%.
Capital and people heavy; loss-making in FY26; results (top ranks) still trail Allen/Kota incumbents.
Annual purchase decisions; students leave after their exam.
Free AI tutors could compress online prices; PW is building its own (AI Guru, Ask AI).
